$comment: Example Claude Code managed settings for rolling Sitecraft out to an Enterprise org. Merge into your existing managed settings (server-managed in the Claude admin console, or managed-settings.json via MDM). Replace the host and repo with yours, and check key names against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org before deploying. Note: allowedMcpServers is an allowlist, so include your other approved servers or remove the key.
